extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Cigna plan available in Volusia County has a $40 monthly premium, a $20 drug deductible and a $3000 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed all compliance rules, including delivering the disclaimer before discussing benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment before scheduling the appointment. The call was focused on a Cigna PDP plan.
composition.coaching_note: Luis did a great job adhering to all compliance rules. The only area for improvement is ensuring the customer signs the Scope of Appointment immediately after it is sent, to avoid any delays. For example, 'Mrs. Lindqvist, I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email. Please sign it now so we can proceed with the plan review.'
